title: TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation
title_zh: TasteRoute：视频生成的个性化路由

paragraphs.en: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator’s own favorite only 34–55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的快速进步催生了大量在能力和生成成本上存在显著差异的模型。 这引出了一个自然的问题：是否可以将每个请求高效地路由到合适的模型？ 我们发现，即使将其他标注者的共识作为参考标准，其与每位标注者个人偏好的吻合率也仅为 34%–55%。 基于这一观察，我们提出了 TasteRoute——一种个性化的视频生成路由系统，它能根据输入请求、用户偏好以及可用生成预算共同选择生成模型。 在文本到视频和图像到视频两种场景下，TasteRoute 在偏好路由方面可与强大的简单基线方法相媲美，同时降低了平均生成成本。 在更高的预算上限下，成本节省效果会更加显著。 最后，我们发布了 TasteRoute-3k——一个由人类标注的数据集，其中包含多模型视频对比、质量评估、偏好排序和用户画像信息，旨在推动未来关于个性化和成本感知型视频路由的研究。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in conditional video generation have led to models with increasingly high visual quality and controllability [ 10 , 8 , 25 , 9 ] . With just a few clicks, users can now generate videos with remarkable visual fidelity. Nevertheless, in practice, models capable of producing comparably high-quality videos can differ substantially in generation cost. Their strengths may also vary: some may produce finer visual detail, while others may better preserve physical plausibility or achieve a desired style. This raises a natural question: which model should a user choose for a given request?
paragraphs.zh: 条件视频生成领域的最新进展催生了视觉质量和可控性日益提升的模型 [ 10 , 8 , 25 , 9 ] 。 如今，用户只需点击几下，就能生成具有卓越视觉保真度的视频。 然而，在实际应用中，能够生成同等高质量视频的模型在生成成本上可能存在显著差异。 它们的优势也可能有所不同：有些模型可能能生成更精细的视觉细节，而另一些则可能更能保持物理合理性或实现预期的风格。 这引出了一个自然的问题：对于给定的请求，用户应该选择哪个模型？

paragraphs.en: At first glance, this question may seem ill-posed, as model selection involves many intricate, entangled factors. The choice becomes more manageable, however, when viewed from the user’s perspective: does a model produce an output that meets their needs, and which qualities matter most to them? Indeed, if the goal is to generate a short transition shot, clear content and coherent motion may have higher priority than fine-grained visual details. Users may therefore seek an output that meets their needs rather than maximize quality along every dimension [ 23 ] . Additionally, individual preferences shape the value of different outputs: one user may favor a stylized rendering, while another prefers photorealism. Even when two models meet the same basic requirements, their outputs may appeal to different users. Model selection should therefore account for both task-specific requirements and individual preferences to determine whether a more expensive model delivers value that justifies its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 乍一看，这个问题似乎表述不当，因为模型选择涉及许多复杂且相互交织的因素。 然而，从用户的角度来看，这一选择会变得更加容易管理：模型生成的输出是否满足他们的需求？哪些特性对他们来说最为重要？ 事实上，如果目标是生成一个简短的过渡镜头，清晰的内容和连贯的运动可能比精细的视觉细节更为重要。 因此，用户可能更倾向于寻求满足其需求的输出，而非在每一个维度上都追求极致质量 [ 23 ] 。 此外，个人偏好会影响不同输出的价值：一位用户可能偏爱风格化的呈现方式，而另一位则可能更青睐照片级的真实感。 即使两个模型都满足了相同的基本需求，它们生成的输出也可能吸引不同的用户。 因此，模型选择应当同时考虑任务特定的需求和个人偏好，以判断一个价格更高的模型是否提供了足以证明其成本的额外价值。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we study the problem of personalized video generation routing. Given a generation request in the form of text and an optional reference image, our goal is to determine which video model to use for a particular user under a given budget. The router makes this choice before generation, considering both whether a model is likely to produce an acceptable output for the input request and how well that output may align with the user’s preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了个性化视频生成路由问题。 给定一个以文本形式提出的生成请求以及一个可选的参考图像，我们的目标是在预算限制下，为特定用户确定应使用哪个视频模型。 路由器在生成前做出这一选择，同时考虑模型是否可能针对输入请求生成可接受的输出，以及该输出与用户偏好的匹配程度。

sents.en: In this paper, we study the problem of personalized video generation routing.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了个性化视频生成路由问题。

sents.en: Given a generation request in the form of text and an optional reference image, our goal is to determine which video model to use for a particular user under a given budget.
sents.zh: 给定一个以文本形式提出的生成请求以及一个可选的参考图像，我们的目标是在预算限制下，为特定用户确定应使用哪个视频模型。

sents.en: The router makes this choice before generation, considering both whether a model is likely to produce an acceptable output for the input request and how well that output may align with the user’s preferences.
sents.zh: 路由器在生成前做出这一选择，同时考虑模型是否可能针对输入请求生成可接受的输出，以及该输出与用户偏好的匹配程度。

paragraphs.en: The task is far from trivial, in part because learning such a router requires data that captures both sides of this decision. To learn user preferences, we need judgments that preserve individual choices rather than aggregate them into a single consensus ranking. To learn which models suit a given request, we need comparisons of outputs from different generators under the same input. These comparisons must also distinguish basic acceptability from subjective preference, so that clear generation failures do not obscure differences in taste among otherwise usable outputs. Unfortunately, such data remains scarce due to heavy reliance on human annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 这项任务远非易事，部分原因在于学习这样的路由器需要能够捕捉到这一决策两方面数据的数据。 为了学习用户偏好，我们需要保留个体选择的判断，而不是将它们汇总成一个单一的共识排名。 为了学习哪些模型适合给定的请求，我们需要在不同生成器在相同输入下的输出之间进行比较。 这些比较还必须区分基本的可接受性与主观偏好，以免明显的生成失败掩盖了其他可用输出之间的品味差异。 遗憾的是，由于过度依赖人工标注，这类数据仍然十分稀缺。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we carefully collect TasteRoute-3K , 1 1 1 Available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/appier-ai-research/tasteroute-3k . a human-annotated dataset with professional written prompts and videos generated by SOTA models that combines quality assessments, diverse preference rankings, and user profiles for videos generated by multiple models under the same request. We find that annotators agree more often when video comparisons involve unacceptable artifacts, but differ substantially when choosing among acceptable ones. Moreover, the preferred generator varies with both the request and the annotator, confirming that routing must account for both. Using this dataset, we further develop TasteRoute , a personalized router that combines representations of the input text and optional image with a learned user embedding. The router predicts basic acceptability alongside a preference score for each candidate generator, allowing it to distinguish shared quality requirements from individual preferences. At inference time, these predictions guide the selection of a generator within the available budget.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们精心收集了 TasteRoute-3K 数据集¹¹¹（可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/appier-ai-research/tasteroute-3k 获取）。这是一个由人类标注的数据集，包含专业撰写的提示词和由 SOTA 模型生成的视频，整合了质量评估、多样化的偏好排序以及同一请求下多个模型生成视频的用户画像。 我们发现，当视频对比涉及不可接受的瑕疵时，标注者往往更容易达成一致；但在可接受的视频中进行选择时，他们的意见则存在显著差异。 此外，首选的生成器会因请求和标注者的不同而有所变化，这证实了路由机制必须同时考虑这两个因素。 基于该数据集，我们进一步开发了 TasteRoute——一种个性化路由器，它将输入文本和可选图像的表达形式与学习得到的用户嵌入相结合。 该路由器能够预测每个候选生成器的基本可接受性及其偏好得分，从而区分通用的质量要求与个人偏好。 在推理阶段，这些预测结果将指导在可用预算范围内选择生成器。

paragraphs.en: Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, we evaluate TasteRoute against generalized and personalized routing. In generalized routing, TasteRoute achieves performance comparable to a strong kNN baseline. In the personalization setting, TasteRoute-Personal reduces the average generation cost by 8–12% at budget caps of $1.0–$2.0 while achieving higher routing accuracy than any other personalized baseline. We further study questionnaire-conditioned routing as a cold-start variant. However, personalization offers limited benefits under tight budgets and remains challenging when users express directly conflicting preferences.

paragraphs.en: The idea of model-level routing, which selects a model for inference based on the input, dates back to classification settings [ 17 , 1 ] , where routing was primarily used to maximize predictive performance. With the emergence of generative models such as LLMs and diffusion models, inference cost has become an additional consideration because serving increasingly capable models requires substantial computation. To maximize quality under a limited cost budget, Chen et al. [3] , Ding et al. [6] study cascade-based routing, while Hu et al. [12] formalizes standardized quality–cost evaluation for model routers. Subsequent work generalizes routing through richer representations and decision mechanisms, including query-based representations [ 4 , 19 ] , graph-based query–model interaction [ 7 ] , multi-armed bandits [ 22 ] , sequential multi-round routing [ 26 ] , and training-free routing [ 24 ] . Beyond optimizing quality and cost, model routing can also support personalization by selecting different models for different users [ 5 , 21 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 模型级路由的概念——即根据输入选择用于推理的模型——可以追溯到分类场景 [17, 1]，当时路由主要用于最大化预测性能。 随着 LLM 和扩散模型等生成式模型的出现，推理成本已成为一个额外的考量因素，因为运行能力日益强大的模型需要大量的计算资源。 为了在有限的成本预算下实现质量最大化，Chen 等人 [3]、Ding 等人 [6] 研究了级联式路由，而 Hu 等人 [12] 则为模型路由器建立了标准化的质量-成本评估框架。 后续研究通过更丰富的表示和决策机制对路由进行了扩展，包括基于查询的表示 [4, 19]、基于图的查询-模型交互 [7]、多臂老虎机问题 [22]、顺序多轮路由 [26] 以及无需训练的路由 [24]。 除了优化质量和成本之外，模型路由还可以通过为不同用户选择不同模型来实现个性化 [5, 21]。

sents.en: Subsequent work generalizes routing through richer representations and decision mechanisms, including query-based representations [ 4 , 19 ] , graph-based query–model interaction [ 7 ] , multi-armed bandits [ 22 ] , sequential multi-round routing [ 26 ] , and training-free routing [ 24 ] .
sents.zh: 后续研究通过更丰富的表示和决策机制对路由进行了扩展，包括基于查询的表示 [4, 19]、基于图的查询-模型交互 [7]、多臂老虎机问题 [22]、顺序多轮路由 [26] 以及无需训练的路由 [24]。

sents.en: Beyond optimizing quality and cost, model routing can also support personalization by selecting different models for different users [ 5 , 21 ] .
sents.zh: 除了优化质量和成本之外，模型路由还可以通过为不同用户选择不同模型来实现个性化 [5, 21]。

paragraphs.en: Most work on model routing targets language models, but some early work has begun to formulate model selection directly for image generation. PAK-UCB [ 13 ] casts prompt-aware generator selection as an online contextual-bandit problem under sequential feedback, using automatic fidelity metrics such as CLIPScore as rewards. More recently, OctoT2I [ 16 ] moves beyond one-shot selection with an agentic, self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers capability profiles across T2I models and uses verifier feedback to guide subsequent routing decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数模型路由研究都针对语言模型，但一些早期的工作已经开始尝试直接为图像生成制定模型选择策略。 PAK-UCB [ 13 ] 将提示感知生成器的选择问题转化为一个在序列反馈下的在线上下文老虎机问题，并使用 CLIPScore 等自动保真度指标作为奖励。 近期，OctoT2I [ 16 ] 突破了一次性选择的限制，采用了一种智能体式的自我演化框架，能够自主发现 T2I 模型的能力特征，并利用验证器的反馈来指导后续的路由决策。

paragraphs.en: Compared with language and image generation, model-level routing for video generation remains unexplored. This setting is particularly suited to routing because video generators differ substantially in both capability and serving cost, with reported 1080p image-to-video prices spanning roughly $0.30–$24.00 per generated minute [ 2 ] , while different users may also prefer different generators for the same request. These disparities motivate routing policies that select video generators according to the request and user rather than relying on a single backend.
paragraphs.zh: 与语言和图像生成相比，视频生成的模型级路由仍是一个未被探索的领域。 这种设置尤其适合用于路由，因为视频生成器在能力和服务成本方面存在显著差异：据报道，1080p 图像转视频的每生成分钟价格大致在 0.30 美元至 24.00 美元之间 [ 2 ]，同时不同用户也可能对同一请求偏好不同的生成器。 这些差异促使我们采用路由策略，根据具体请求和用户选择视频生成器，而不是依赖单一的后台系统。

paragraphs.en: Existing video-preference datasets are not well suited for training a video router. They either evaluate earlier models [ 20 , 11 ] whose outputs are often dominated by obvious artifacts, or contain relatively few human preference annotations [ 15 ] . For example, Huang et al. [14] contains only 1,150 human-annotated pairs, with the remainder labeled by a calibrated Gemini 3.1 judge. Crowd-sourced leaderboards such as Artificial Analysis’s Video Arena collect feedback across a broader range of generators [ 2 ] but do not release their data.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的视频偏好数据集并不适合用于训练视频路由器。 这些数据集要么评估早期模型 [ 20 , 11 ]，其输出往往受到明显人工痕迹的主导；要么包含较少的人类偏好标注 [ 15 ]。 例如，Huang 等人 [14] 仅包含 1,150 对人类标注的成对数据，其余数据则由经过校准的 Gemini 3.1 评判者标注。 像 Artificial Analysis 的 Video Arena 这类众包排行榜收集了来自更广泛生成器的反馈 [ 2 ]，但并未公开其数据。

paragraphs.en: We study video-generation routing, where a router selects a generator for each text-to-video (T2V) or image-to-video (I2V) request under a generation budget. Given a request and a pool of candidate generators with known costs, the router scores every candidate and selects the highest-scoring one whose cost is within the budget. In personalized routing, the score additionally depends on the user.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究视频生成路由问题，其中路由器在生成预算的约束下，为每个文本到视频（T2V）或图像到视频（I2V）请求选择一个生成器。 给定一个请求和一组已知成本的候选生成器，路由器会为每个候选生成器打分，并选择得分最高且成本在预算范围内的生成器。 在个性化路由中，评分还会依赖于用户。

paragraphs.en: Learning such a router requires multi-generator video comparisons under the same request, preferences recorded at the individual level, and a separate assessment of video acceptability. Therefore we construct TasteRoute-3k , a human-annotated video-routing dataset built around these requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 学习这样一个路由器需要在相同请求下对多个生成器生成的视频进行比较，记录个体层面的偏好，并对视频的接受度进行单独评估。 因此，我们构建了 TasteRoute-3k——一个围绕这些要求构建的、由人类标注的视频路由数据集。

paragraphs.en: We begin by collecting 277 video-generation prompts, used as text-only inputs for text-to-video (T2V) and paired with a reference image for image-to-video (I2V). Approximately half of the prompts are drawn from an existing collection [ 11 ] , while the rest are written by professional video creators with more demanding requirements, such as timestamp-specific motion and camera movement. A prompt may be used in both settings, giving 394 requests (274 T2V and 120 I2V). We then generate candidate videos from a catalog of 30 generator endpoints, covering 16:9 and 9:16 aspect ratios with durations of 4, 6, and 10 seconds, for a total of 3,128 annotated videos. Table 1 summarizes the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先收集了 277 个视频生成提示，这些提示仅作为文本输入用于文本到视频（T2V）生成，并与参考图像配对用于图像到视频（I2V）生成。 大约一半的提示来自现有集合 [ 11 ]，其余则由有更高要求的专业视频创作者编写，例如需要特定时间戳的动作和摄像机移动。 一个提示可能在这两种设置中都被使用，从而产生 394 个请求（274 个 T2V 和 120 个 I2V）。 接着，我们从包含 30 个生成器端点的目录中生成候选视频，这些端点覆盖了 16:9 和 9:16 的宽高比，以及 4、6 和 10 秒的时长，总共生成了 3,128 段带标注的视频。 表 1 总结了该数据集。

paragraphs.en: Nine annotators (four general, five professional video creators) participate in the labeling. Before labeling, all annotators must first complete a calibration meeting on the interface and rubric, covering details such as what a text artifact looks like. We deliberately do not calibrate the aesthetic preference since it is the signal that we wish to capture for personalization.
paragraphs.zh: 九名标注员（四名普通标注员，五名专业视频创作者）参与标注工作。 在开始标注前，所有标注员必须先在界面上完成一次关于评分标准的校准会议，内容涵盖文本元素的具体表现形式等细节。 我们刻意不对审美偏好进行校准，因为正是这种偏好构成了我们希望捕捉用于个性化设置的关键信号。

paragraphs.en: Three units recur throughout the paper. The catalog is the full list of 30 generator endpoints (Appendix E ); the pool of a request is the generators whose outputs are labeled for it; and a group is what one annotator ranks at a time, at most six videos drawn from one pool. A large pool is therefore covered by several overlapping groups; the group is the unit annotators work in, and the pool is the unit of every aggregation and evaluation that follows.
paragraphs.zh: 全文中出现了三个单元。 目录是 30 个生成器端点的完整列表（附录 E）；请求的池是指那些输出被标记为该请求的生成器；而一个组则是一个标注员一次排序的内容，最多包含从一个池中抽取的六个视频。 因此，一个大池由多个重叠的组覆盖；组是标注员工作的单元，而池则是后续所有汇总和评估的单元。

paragraphs.en: Our annotation pipeline separates video quality acceptability from subjective preference. Annotators first evaluate each video’s quality using a shared rubric, then rank candidate videos according to their individual preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的标注流程将视频质量的可接受性与主观偏好区分开来。 标注人员首先使用统一的标准来评估每个视频的质量，然后根据各自的偏好对候选视频进行排序。

sents.en: Our annotation pipeline separates video quality acceptability from subjective preference.
sents.zh: 我们的标注流程将视频质量的可接受性与主观偏好区分开来。

sents.en: Annotators first evaluate each video’s quality using a shared rubric, then rank candidate videos according to their individual preferences.
sents.zh: 标注人员首先使用统一的标准来评估每个视频的质量，然后根据各自的偏好对候选视频进行排序。

paragraphs.en: In the first stage, annotators assess each video along four rubric criteria: (i) Text integrity : whether visible text is malformed, hallucinated, or unreadable; (ii) Motion consistency : whether motion shows smearing, discontinuities, or implausible movement; (iii) Subject realism : do subjects have misformed features or physically implausible rendering; and (iv) Instructions following : does the video follow the conditioning prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段，标注员会依据四个评分标准对每个视频进行评估：(i) 文本完整性：可见文本是否存在格式错误、幻觉或无法阅读的情况；(ii) 运动一致性：运动是否存在模糊、不连贯或不合理的移动；(iii) 主体真实性：主体是否存在特征畸形或物理上不合理的渲染；以及 (iv) 指令遵循：视频是否遵循了条件提示。

paragraphs.en: Each criterion is rated reject , borderline , or accept , as is overall acceptability, giving five quality fields per video. The acceptability score remains per-annotator and is never pooled such that a video one annotator rejects may still be ranked by another (Section 5 analyzes these disagreements).
paragraphs.zh: 每个标准都会被评定为“拒绝”“临界”或“接受”，整体可接受性也是如此，因此每个视频会有五个质量字段。 可接受性评分仍保持每位标注者独立，绝不会合并计算，因此一位标注者拒绝的视频，另一位标注者可能仍然会给予较高排名（第 5 节分析了这些分歧）。

paragraphs.en: Following quality assessment, annotators rank candidate videos according to their individual preferences, with ties allowed. Each group includes two anchor videos shared with the other groups of the same pool, which connect their rankings. We prioritize comparisons between similarly ranked generators to better resolve their relative preferences, while randomly sampling a subset of groups to maintain broader coverage of generator pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 在质量评估之后，标注人员会根据个人偏好对候选视频进行排序，允许出现并列情况。 每个小组都包含两个与同一池中的其他小组共享的基准视频，这些视频用于连接各小组的排名。 我们优先对排名相近的生成器进行比较，以更好地确定它们的相对偏好，同时随机抽取部分小组作为样本，以保持对生成器组合更广泛的覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Each annotator also completes a five-item questionnaire covering self-reported preferences for video qualities (e.g., prompt accuracy, natural motion, etc). Because self-reported preferences may not reflect actual choices, each annotator also completes four reference-video comparisons, choosing between videos A and B, indicating no preference, or selecting cannot judge. After selecting either A or B, annotators additionally report their preference strength and up to two perceptual factors (e.g. motion naturalness, camera framing, etc.). These responses provide the cold-start preference signal for video routing (Section 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每位标注者还需完成一份包含五个问题的问卷，内容涉及其对视频质量的自我报告偏好（例如，提示准确性、自然运动等）。 由于自我报告的偏好可能无法反映实际选择，每位标注者还需完成四项参考视频对比任务，在视频 A 和 B 之间做出选择，表示无偏好，或选择无法判断。 在选择 A 或 B 之后，标注者还需报告其偏好的强度以及最多两个感知因素（例如，运动自然度、镜头构图等）。 这些回应为视频路由提供了冷启动偏好信号（第 6.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: For the general routing task we aggregate annotations within each pool. Each cross-generator video pair takes the outcome that the most annotators chose among win, loss and tie, and carries the number of annotators behind it as its weight; a pair with no strict plurality is ambiguous and is dropped. On the rest we fit a weighted Bradley–Terry (BT) model, one per connected component of each pool’s comparison graph, with ties counted as half a win and weights normalized by the number of comparisons the originating listwise ranking induces. Its win probabilities are the soft ranking targets of Section 6.2 , yielding 7,062 consensus training pairs. We train on these probabilities because they place every generator of a pool on one smooth scale, but score every analysis and evaluation with the consensus utility of Section 5 , which needs no model fit and keeps the ground truth independent of the training target.
paragraphs.zh: 对于通用路由任务，我们在每个池内聚合标注结果。 每对跨生成器的视频会采用多数标注者在“胜、负、平”中选择的最终结果，并将选择该结果的标注者人数作为其权重；若没有明确多数意见，则视为模糊并予以舍弃。 对于其余情况，我们为每个池的比较图中的每个连通分量拟合一个加权布拉德利–特里（BT）模型，其中平局计为半个胜利，权重则通过原始列表排名所引发的比较次数进行归一化。 其获胜概率即为第 6.2 节中的软排名目标，由此得到 7,062 个共识训练对。 我们基于这些概率进行训练，因为它们将池内的每个生成器置于一个平滑的尺度上；同时，所有分析和评估均使用第 5 节中的共识效用进行评分，这种方式无需模型拟合，且能保持真实标签与训练目标相互独立。

paragraphs.en: With this dataset in hand, we examine what a video router needs to learn: (i) how generator strengths depend on the request, (ii) which preferences are shared across annotators, and (iii) when individual preferences diverge. Within a pool, each video pair takes the outcome that the most annotators chose (Section 4.2 ), and each generator receives a consensus utility : its win rate over the pairs it appears in, counting a win as 1 1 and a tie as 0.5 0.5 , with each pair weighted by the number of annotators behind it. The top-scoring generator is the consensus winner .
paragraphs.zh: 基于这份数据集，我们研究了视频路由器需要学习的内容：(i) 生成器的优势如何取决于请求；(ii) 哪些偏好是标注员之间共有的；以及 (iii) 个体偏好何时出现分歧。 在一个池子中，每对视频都采用多数标注员选择的输出结果（第 4.2 节），每个生成器则获得一个共识效用值：即它在所参与的视频对中获胜的次数，其中获胜计为 1，平局计为 0.5，且每对视频按其后标注员的数量进行加权。 得分最高的生成器即为共识获胜者。

paragraphs.en: If one generator consistently performed best, a fixed choice would suffice. We therefore examine how generator performance varies across prompt attributes (e.g. animation style) in Figure 1 (left): each cell shows the difference between a generator’s mean consensus utility on prompts with a given attribute and without the given attribute. In T2V, Veo 3.1 Lite has the highest consensus utility overall, yet it loses 5 of the 12 attributes to three rivals: Seedance 2.0 Mini on face close-ups, Kling 2.5 Pro on animals, and Grok Imagine on product / UI, quoted text and camera motion. A near-zero mean score means the prompt changes who wins, which is what a router can exploit.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个生成器始终表现最佳，那么固定选择它即可。 因此，我们在图 1（左侧）中研究了生成器性能在不同提示属性（例如动画风格）上的差异：每个单元格显示的是生成器在具有特定属性的提示与不具有该属性的提示上平均共识效用的差异。 在 T2V 中，Veo 3.1 Lite 的总体共识效用最高，但在 12 个属性中有 5 个输给了三个竞争对手：Seedance 2.0 Mini 在面部特写方面胜出，Kling 2.5 Pro 在动物方面胜出，而 Grok Imagine 则在产品/UI、引文文本和相机运动方面胜出。 接近零的平均分数意味着提示会改变获胜者，而这正是路由器可以利用的。

paragraphs.en: Agreement is how often two annotators who judged the same video pair prefer the same video. We measure it on 19,338 doubly-judged comparisons over 376 pools and nine annotators, each one a video pair with two annotators who both expressed a decisive preference. Figure 2 splits these pairs by annotator-assessed acceptability and defect flags. When either annotator rejected either video, annotators agree 83–85% of the time: bad output is bad for everyone. Agreement then decreases as the videos get better, to 64–66% when both are acceptable but one carries a defect flag, and to 57% (T2V) and 62% (I2V) when both are clean, barely above the 50% of a coin flip. Quality explains agreement, but prompt content does not: of 16 video attributes, only cartoon or 3D prompts robustly raise agreement on clean pairs ( + 18 % +18\% ). Prompts that ask for exact on-screen text show the largest negative trend ( − 10 % -10\% ). See Figure 10 in Appendix B for the full breakdown.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性指的是，在判断同一视频对时，两名标注者倾向于选择相同视频的频率。 我们在 376 个分组和九名标注者中，基于 19,338 组经过双重判断的比较来衡量这一指标；每组比较都包含一个视频对以及两名均表达了明确偏好的标注者。 图 2 根据标注者评估的接受度和缺陷标记，对这些视频对进行了分类。 当任意一名标注者拒绝任一视频时，标注者的一致性达到 83%–85%：糟糕的输出对所有人来说都是糟糕的。 随着视频质量提升，一致性随之下降：当两个视频均可接受但其中一个带有缺陷标记时，一致性降至 64%–66%；而当两个视频均无问题时，一致性分别降至 57%（T2V）和 62%（I2V），仅略高于抛硬币的 50% 概率。 质量可以解释一致性，但提示内容则不然：在 16 个视频属性中，只有卡通或 3D 提示能显著提升干净视频对的一致性（+18% +18\%）。 要求精确呈现屏幕文本的提示显示出最显著的负向趋势（−10% -10\%）。 完整的分类分析请参见附录 B 中的图 10。

paragraphs.en: For every pool an annotator labeled, we take the option preferred by the other annotators and check whether it matches this annotator’s own top choice; no model training is involved. paragraphs.en: These findings motivate a routing framework that captures both shared and individual preferences. A generalized router learns how generator preferences vary across prompts from pooled judgments, while a personalized router additionally models individual preferences among acceptable outputs. A single architecture supports both by conditioning on the prompt and, when available, user information (Section 6.1 ). The BT soft targets of Section 4.2 represent pooled preferences probabilistically rather than reducing them to hard winner–loser labels.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现促使我们提出一种能够同时捕捉共享偏好和个体偏好的路由框架。 通用路由器通过汇总判断学习生成器偏好如何因提示而异，而个性化路由器则进一步对可接受输出中的个体偏好进行建模。 单一架构通过以提示以及（在可用时）用户信息为条件来实现这两种模式（第 6.1 节）。 第 4.2 节中 BT 的软目标以概率方式表示汇总偏好，而非将其简化为明确的胜败标签。

We describe the architecture and how it conditions on a user (Section 6.1 ), then the objectives of the two variants (Section 6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Each video generator request is first encoded using the multimodal Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B encoder [ 18 ] , taking text prompt for T2V and both text prompt and reference image for I2V. Video generator is represented by a learned embedding. paragraphs.en: kNN [ 19 ] : retrieves the k k most similar training prompts using the same embedding models as TasteRoute and ranks generators by the mean observed utility ( k k chosen on validation); Same-user kNN implements the personalized version of kNN routing by limiting to only a single annotator rather than the aggregated mean observed utility in kNN.
paragraphs.zh: kNN [ 19 ]：使用与 TasteRoute 相同的嵌入模型，检索出 k 个最相似的训练提示，并根据观测到的平均效用对生成器进行排序（k 在验证集上选定）；同一用户 kNN 通过仅限定于单个标注者（而非 kNN 中的聚合平均观测效用），实现了 kNN 路由的个性化版本。

paragraphs.en: Octo [ 16 ] : an agentic video-adapted image router. It selects the cheapest generator whose remembered pass rate for the prompt’s capability bucket exceeds a threshold, then verifies the output, and escalates on rejection for up to four attempts. We evaluate VideoScore2 [ 11 ] , GPT-5.6, Gemini 3.7 Flash as verifiers, and include human labels as signal for upper-bound ( Octo-Human-Label ).

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 A shows that TasteRoute-Generic and kNN achieve similar NDCG across budget caps. At the $2.0 cap, TasteRoute-Generic reaches 42.0% Top-1, compared with 39.7% for kNN, 38.2% for FrugalGPT, and 33.6% for Octo. These results suggest that learning prompt–generator interactions offers limited improvement over retrieval under pooled preferences. With an oracle verifier using held-out human labels, Octo reaches 58.0% Top-1, highlighting the role of verification quality in generate-then-verify routing.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5A 显示，在各类预算上限下，TasteRoute-Generic 和 kNN 实现的 NDCG 值相近。 在 $2.0 的预算上限下，TasteRoute-Generic 的 Top-1 准确率达到 42.0%，而 kNN 为 39.7%，FrugalGPT 为 38.2%，Octo 为 33.6%。 这些结果表明，在偏好池化条件下，学习提示与生成器之间的交互对检索性能的提升有限。 当使用预留的人类标签作为“神谕”验证器时，Octo 的 Top-1 准确率达到 58.0%，这凸显了验证质量在“先生成后验证”的路由策略中所起的作用。

paragraphs.en: Next we examine whether a simpler attribute-based lookup can replace a learned router. Figure 6 shows that generator preferences vary across prompt attributes, with TasteRoute-Generic’s Top-1 ranging from 48.6% on cartoon and 3D prompts to 30.4% on prompts requesting rendered text. Prompt attributes provide some useful routing signal, yet a per-attribute lookup table achieves only 37.0% Top-1 accuracy, compared with 36.6% for a single global-best generator and 39.9% for TasteRoute-Generic. This suggests that the learned router exploits prompt-dependent information beyond coarse attribute categories. To examine its sensitivity to request, we modify one attribute phrase while keeping the remaining prompt unchanged. These edits alter TasteRoute-Generic’s top-ranked generator in 5–55% of cases across ten attributes, with an average flip rate of 25%.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将研究一个更简单的基于属性的查找方法是否可以取代一个经过学习的智能体。 图6显示，生成器的偏好因提示属性而异：TasteRoute-Generic 的 Top-1 准确率从卡通和3D提示下的48.6%到要求渲染文本的提示下的30.4%不等。 提示属性提供了一些有用的路由信号，但每个属性单独建立的查找表仅能达到37.0%的 Top-1 准确率，而单一全局最佳生成器的准确率为36.6%，TasteRoute-Generic 的准确率为39.9%。 这表明，经过学习的智能体利用了超出粗略属性类别之外的、与提示相关的信息。 为了研究其对请求的敏感度，我们在保持其余提示不变的情况下修改其中一个属性短语。 这些修改在十个属性中导致 TasteRoute-Generic 的首选生成器在5%至55%的情况下发生变化，平均翻转率为25%。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 B shows that both TasteRoute variants perform competitively with kNN, Hierarchical User-BT, and PersonalizedRouter-GNN across budget caps. TasteRoute-Personal performs similarly to TasteRoute-Generic below $1.1 per video but pulls ahead as the budget increases. paragraphs.en: To study personalization with limited user feedback, we vary the number of labeled prompt groups used for training (Figure 5 C). paragraphs.en: Building on the overall performance gains, we further analyze how personalized routing is improved from generic routing in terms of generation cost and alignment with individual preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 在整体性能提升的基础上，我们进一步分析了个性化路由相较于通用路由在生成成本以及与个人偏好契合度方面的改进情况。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 plots each router’s mean cost against routing quality at every budget cap. NDCG of routing quality is calculated over the affordable pool instead of the full pool used in Figure 5 . At the $1.0, $1.5, and $2.0 budget caps, TasteRoute-Personal is the cheapest and most accurate router, reducing cost by 8% to 12.0% compared to the most expensive alternatives at the same caps. Only at the $0.5 budget cap, TasteRoute-Generic-Pooled is marginally ahead on both axes. TasteRoute is trained without cost supervision, and the budget cap is only an affordability filter at inference time, so this saving is a byproduct of the learned preference ranking: the preferred generators are not the expensive ones.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 绘制了每个路由器在每种预算上限下的平均成本与路由质量的关系。 路由质量的 NDCG 是在可负担的池子中计算的，而不是图 5 中使用的完整池子。 在 $1.0、$1.5 和 $2.0 的预算上限下，TasteRoute-Personal 是最便宜且最准确的路由器，与相同上限下最昂贵的替代方案相比，成本降低了 8% 到 12.0%。 只有在 $0.5 的预算上限下，TasteRoute-Generic-Pooled 在两个指标上才略微领先。 TasteRoute 在没有成本监督的情况下进行训练，而预算上限在推理时仅作为一个可负担性过滤器，因此这种成本节省是所学习到的偏好排序的副产品：首选的生成器并非那些昂贵的生成器。

paragraphs.en: Saving cost is also learnable: following Li [19] , we applied a user-defined trade-off parameter governing the preference for performance versus cost, the full sweep over parameters and budget caps is given in Table 2 . A parameter small enough makes Top-1 unchanged at every cap and saves at most 0.03%. paragraphs.en: We presented TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset of multi-generator video comparisons, and TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator from the request, the user’s preferences and the available budget. TasteRoute-3k shows that preferences over video generators are both diverse and conflicting across annotators, and that a router conditioned on annotator identity improves over generalized routing once the budget no longer constrains the choice. TasteRoute outperforms every personalized baseline at every budget cap and, from the $1.0 cap upward, is simultaneously the cheapest and the most accurate router. Our analyses of opposite-preference pairs, of the cost–preference trade-off, and of the link between prompt attributes and personalization show that the router encodes annotator-specific preference but mostly corrects the consensus rather than resolving conflicts between users. Closing that gap, with user-conditioned features that raise accuracy without raising generation cost, is the direction we see for future work, alongside understanding how human preference over generated video differs from preference over text and images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TasteRoute-3k——一个由人类标注的多生成器视频对比数据集，以及 TasteRoute——一个个性化视频生成路由器，它会根据请求、用户偏好和可用预算来选择生成器。 TasteRoute-3k 表明，不同标注者对视频生成器的偏好既多样化又存在冲突；一旦预算不再限制选择，基于标注者身份的路由器性能优于通用路由方案。 在所有预算上限下，TasteRoute 的表现均优于所有个性化基线模型；从 1.0 美元上限开始，它同时成为成本最低且最准确的路由器。 我们对相反偏好对、成本与偏好的权衡关系，以及提示词属性与个性化之间关联性的分析表明，该路由器编码了标注者特定的偏好，但主要是在修正共识，而非解决用户之间的冲突。 我们看好的未来研究方向是：通过引入用户相关的特征来缩小这一差距，在提升准确性的同时不增加生成成本；此外，还需理解人类对生成视频的偏好与对文本、图像的偏好有何不同。

paragraphs.en: Octo keeps a capability memory of per-generator pass rates over prompt-derived capability buckets built from training-fold verifier outcomes, routes to the cheapest generator whose expected pass rate exceeds a threshold (threshold and minimum bucket count selected on validation), and escalates to the next-cheapest generator for up to four attempts when the verifier rejects the output. The verifier rates visual quality, prompt alignment and physical consistency on a 1–5 scale and accepts a video when the mean is at least 4.0 4.0 and every dimension at least 3.0 3.0 . FrugalGPT learns, per budget, a cascade order of up to four generators and per-stage acceptance thresholds on the training split, selects the configuration on validation, and replays it frozen at test time under a per-pool cumulative cost cap; the last affordable stage always returns its output. Both use the verifier’s mean rubric score as the answer scorer; generation cost accumulates over attempts and verifier API or compute cost is reported separately. kNN was tuned over k ∈ { 1 , 10 , 20 , 30 , 50 , 100 } k\in\{1,10,20,30,50,100\} .
paragraphs.zh: Octo 会记录每个生成器在基于训练集验证结果构建的、由提示词衍生的能力桶中的通过率记忆，并路由到预期通过率超过阈值（阈值和最小桶数在验证集上选定）的最便宜的生成器；当验证器拒绝输出时，它会升级到次便宜的生成器，最多尝试四次。 验证器会在 1–5 分制上对视觉质量、提示词对齐和物理一致性进行评分，并且当平均得分至少为 4.0 且每个维度的得分至少为 3.0 时接受视频。 FrugalGPT 会针对每个预算，在训练集上学习最多四个生成器的级联顺序以及各阶段的接受阈值，在验证集上选择配置，并在测试时以冻结状态、在每池累计成本上限内重复执行该流程；最后一个可负担的阶段总会返回其输出。 两者都使用验证器的平均评分作为答案评分标准；生成成本会随尝试次数累积，而验证器 API 或计算成本则单独报告。kNN 在 k ∈ { 1 , 10 , 20 , 30 , 50 , 100 } 范围内进行了调优。

sents.en: Each annotator first completes a six-step preference onboarding that initializes their preference profile (Figures 15 – 18 ), and then labels prompts in a ranking interface that collects both per-video quality ratings and listwise preference rankings (Figure 19 ).
sents.zh: 每位标注者首先完成一个包含六个步骤的偏好引导流程，以初始化其偏好配置文件（图 15–18），随后在一个排序界面中为提示词添加标签，该界面同时收集单个视频的质量评分和列表式偏好排序（图 19）。

paragraphs.en: The onboarding opens with a five-item questionnaire on self-reported preferences: the qualities that matter most (up to two), the preferred video type, motion amount, camera treatment, and overall visual treatment (Figure 15 ). Throughout onboarding, a banner reminds annotators that there is no correct answer and that they should choose the result they would rather receive. To make this framing explicit, annotators then answer a quick comprehension check asking what the preference examples ask them to choose (Figure 16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 引导流程以一份包含五个问题的自我报告偏好问卷开始：最重要的特质（最多两项）、首选的视频类型、运动量、相机处理方式以及整体视觉风格（图 15）。 在整个引导过程中，一个横幅会提醒标注员，这里没有正确答案，他们应选择自己更希望得到的结果。 为了明确这一设定，标注员随后需要完成一个简短的理解检查问题，询问偏好示例要求他们做出何种选择（图 16）。

paragraphs.en: Because self-reported preferences may not reflect actual choices, the remaining onboarding steps present four reference-video comparisons. Annotators watch two generations for the same prompt and choose A, B, no preference, or cannot judge (Figure 17 ). The follow-up questions depend on the choice (Figure 18 ): selecting A or B asks for up to two factors that influenced the choice and the preference strength (slight, moderate, strong); selecting no preference asks only for the influencing factors; and selecting cannot judge asks for a reason (playback problem, both videos unacceptable, difference not meaningful, or unclear prompt).
paragraphs.zh: 由于自我报告的偏好可能无法反映实际选择，因此后续的上手步骤会提供四个参考视频对比。 标注员需要观看同一提示词生成的两个版本，然后选择 A、B、无偏好或无法判断（图 17）。 后续问题取决于所选选项（图 18）：选择 A 或 B 时，需回答最多两个影响选择的因素以及偏好的强度（轻微、中等、强烈）；选择“无偏好”时，只需回答影响因素；而选择“无法判断”时，则需说明原因（播放问题、两个视频均不可接受、差异不显著或提示词不清）。

sents.zh: 后续问题取决于所选选项（图 18）：选择 A 或 B 时，需回答最多两个影响选择的因素以及偏好的强度（轻微、中等、强烈）；选择“无偏好”时，只需回答影响因素；而选择“无法判断”时，则需说明原因（播放问题、两个视频均不可接受、差异不显著或提示词不清）。

paragraphs.en: After onboarding, annotators label prompts in the ranking interface (Figure 19 ). The left panel lists prompts by task (general or business, T2V or I2V) with their completion status, and the top of the main panel shows the conditioning prompt with its key entities highlighted. For each video, annotators first provide the five quality fields (text issues, motion artifacts, human realism, instruction following, and overall acceptability) on a 3-point scale. They then arrange the candidate videos into rank groups by dragging or using the up/down controls; placing several videos in one group expresses a tie, and a group can be split to break it.
paragraphs.zh: 在入职培训后，标注员会在排名界面（图 19）中对提示进行标注。 左侧面板按任务类型（通用或业务、T2V 或 I2V）列出提示及其完成状态，主面板顶部则显示条件提示，其中关键实体已被高亮显示。 对于每个视频，标注员首先使用 3 分制对五个质量维度（文本问题、运动伪影、人类真实感、指令遵循以及整体可接受性）进行评分。 随后，他们通过拖拽或使用上下控制键将候选视频分组排名；将多个视频置于同一组中表示并列，而拆分一个组则可以打破并列关系。
